title: ¿Me oyes? Videollamadas
goal: a manejarte en una videollamada y a decir desde cuándo tienes o haces algo

ex.t: We have a video call every Sunday.
ex.es: Hacemos una videollamada todos los domingos.

ex.t: Hello? Can you hear me now?
Mum, you're on mute! Tap the microphone.
ex.es: ¡Mamá, tienes el micro quitado! Toca el micrófono.
Perdona, se ha congelado la pantalla.

ex.t: I've got a bad signal in the village.
ex.es: En el pueblo tengo mala cobertura.

ex.t: How long have you had this laptop?
I haven't seen you for ages!

pron.title: La i de since y la ee de seen
pron.tip: Since tiene una i corta y relajada; seen, una i larga. No las confundas: since 2015 / I've seen it.

exercises.q: I've had this tablet ___ three years.
We've had a video call every Sunday ___ Christmas.
exercises.why: Christmas es el momento de inicio: since.

exercises.q: Mum, you're on ___! We can't hear you.
exercises.es: Mamá, ¡tienes el micro silenciado! No te oímos.

exercises.q: How long have you ___ this phone?
exercises.why: How long have you had…? (have → had).

answer: I have had this laptop since 2021.
exercises.why: Empezó y sigue: present perfect (have had).

exercises.q: I've used this app since two years.

exercises.context: En plena videollamada con tu hijo, ves que te habla pero no le oyes nada.
options: Sorry, I can't hear you. Are you on mute?
Sorry, I don't listen you. Are you mute?
exercises.answer: Sorry, I can't hear you. Are you on mute?
exercises.why: No te oigo = I can't hear you; on mute = silenciado.

exercises.title: Un mensaje de Emma
exercises.text: Hi Yolanda! I haven't heard from you for ages. Have you got a new phone? My video calls haven't worked since Monday. I think the wifi is the problem. Can we try again on Sunday at six? Emma

questions.q: ¿Desde cuándo no le funcionan las videollamadas a Emma?

exercises.t: Can you hear me now? I think I was on mute.
exercises.es: ¿Me oyes ahora? Creo que tenía el micro silenciado.

dialog.title: La videollamada del domingo
dialog.setting: Yolanda hace una videollamada con su hijo Hugo desde la cocina

lines.t: Hi Mum! Can you hear me?
Hello? I can see you, but I can't hear you.
lines.es: ¿Hola? Te veo, pero no te oigo.

lines.t: Mum, you're on mute! Tap the microphone.
lines.es: ¡Mamá, tienes el micro quitado! Toca el micrófono.

lines.t: Oh! Can you hear me now?
Yes, perfectly. Is that a new tablet?
No, I've had it for two years! You've seen it before.
lines.es: ¡No, la tengo desde hace dos años! Ya la has visto.

lines.t: Ha ha, sorry. Wait… the screen has frozen.
lines.es: Ja, ja, perdona. Espera… se ha congelado la pantalla.

lines.t: The signal is bad here. I'll call you back.
lines.es: Aquí hay mala cobertura. Te vuelvo a llamar.

questions.q: ¿Por qué Hugo no oía a su madre?

realLife.t: Sorry, I can't hear you. I'll call you back.
realLife.es: Perdona, no te oigo. Te vuelvo a llamar.
realLife.context: Cuando falla la llamada o la videollamada

summary: Can you hear me? / You're on mute / It's frozen
for + duración: for two years, for ages
since + momento de inicio: since 2015, since Christmas
Desde cuándo tienes…? = How long have you had…?
